name: Suspicious Comment / AI Confession Marker

patterns.re: (?i)in production(?:,| you| this| we| it)|in a real (?:app|system|deployment|world)|for (?:demo|example|testing|illustration) purposes|replace (?:this )?with your|your (?:real |actual )?(?:api[_-]?key|secret|token|password)(?: goes)? here|not for production|do not use in production|skip(?:ping)? (?:auth|authentication|validation|verification) for now
示例|简化实现|仅供演示|生产环境中|实际生产|실제로는|프로덕션에서는|セキュリティは省略

attack_scenario: an AI assistant ships insecure or incomplete code and admits it in a nearby comment ('replace with your real key', 'TODO: add auth', 'in production you would validate') - the comment ships to production unread and the gap becomes a live vulnerability
negative_test_hint: add a temporary "NOT SECURE - placeholder" marker comment and assert the pre-release sweep catches it before ship

exemplar.noncompliant: app.run(host="0.0.0.0")  # TODO: add authentication before production
exemplar.compliant: app.run(host="127.0.0.1")  # auth enforced by @login_required on every route
exemplar.explanation: resolve the confessed gap before shipping; a comment admitting missing auth/validation is a real, unfinished security hole
